title: Nourishing Tunisian Cranberries Crumble
description: A warm, crumbly crumble with dried cranberries, spices, and a nutty topping. Perfect for a comforting dessert that feels like a Tunisian sweet treat.
instructions: Set oven to 180C and preheat a tava-griddle on medium heat.
In a bowl whisk applesauce, lemon juice, maple syrup, vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg until smooth.
In a second bowl combine oat flour and baking powder.
Pour almond butter and melted coconut oil into the wet mixture and stir until glossy.
Fold the dry mixture into the wet mixture until just combined.
Spread the batter evenly onto the preheated tava-griddle.
Cover with a lid and cook for 8 minutes until the edges begin to set.
Flip the batter and cook for another 8 minutes until golden brown and firm.
Remove, let rest 2 minutes, then serve warm with extra dried cranberries on top.
